what: priority §1א, first bug — 'logging in dumps the user back on the brochure page with their name on top instead of into the product'. Driven through a real browser as the test customer for the first time; until now the account was proven only at the auth API layer.
how: Playwright against more30.com production, each URL with ?cachebust= so the answer is not a CDN copy from before the last deploy.

flow_under_test.1_start_inside_a_product: https://more30.com/bkalot/ — the shared login pill (portal/public/auth-button.js) renders 'כניסה' and its menu item carries the current address: /login?from=https%3A%2F%2Fmore30.com%2Fbkalot%2F%3Fcachebust%3D0812a
flow_under_test.2_login_page_keeps_it: on /login, sessionStorage['more30-return-to'] === '/bkalot/?cachebust=0812a' — safeReturnPath() accepted the absolute more30.com URL and stored it as a path
flow_under_test.4_landing: https://more30.com/bkalot/?cachebust=0812a — the page the user started on, NOT /me and NOT the portal home
flow_under_test.5_signed_in_state: pill label 'לקוח', menu head 'מחובר כ־לקוח בדיקה', items = האזור האישי · שדרוג לפרימיום · יציאה

verdict: PASS for the shared-pill flow. §1א's first bug does not reproduce on the platform login. This covers every static system that ships auth-button.js, not only bkalot.

also_measured.check: does a plain customer reach the super-admin screens?
also_measured.result: REFUSED — 'החשבון הזה אינו סופר-אדמין / super admin only'. No admin data rendered.

also_measured.check: personal area, and the way back out of it
also_measured.result: shows שם מלא 'לקוח בדיקה', כתובת אימייל test@more30.com, סוג חשבון 'משתמש', and the 'חזרה למערכת' button is present — the from= value is honoured here too, which is what §1 asks for.

also_measured.check: does the hub session carry across sites?
also_measured.result: yes — the pill reads 'לקוח' on galil without logging in again

findings_not_fixed_here.what: the 'ניהול' link is rendered for every visitor, including a signed-in customer who is not a super-admin. It is not a leak — the target refuses correctly (above) — but it is a dead end: the customer clicks a management link and is told the account is not allowed.
findings_not_fixed_here.why_not_fixed_now: §5א explicitly wants system 10's management reachable from the home page, so hiding the link is a product decision, not a cleanup. Fixing it properly means auth-button.js publishing the admin verdict the page can read, and that is its own step.

findings_not_fixed_here.what: re-checked this run as the previous step asked. POST /auth/v1/resend answered 200 again and the Resend inbox still holds nothing newer than 02:40:06Z — i.e. no confirmation mail was delivered on either attempt. The account exists (signup → user_already_exists) and login still answers 400.
findings_not_fixed_here.conclusion: not a matter of waiting longer; it needs the user's Supabase console. Stays the NEEDS_USER item it already is.

still_open_for_the_next_step: the per-system logins (24 galil, 30 crm, 31 gesher, 21 mthbram, 15 egod, 06/12/17/27, 01/02/03/10/18) are proven at the auth API only. Systems with their own login screen — galil's פורטל גבאים at /galil/gabai is the clearest — have not been driven through a browser as this user.
